reproduction_history.player_resolution: The first current-player run used two obsolete assertions: title hold must create Resume, and resize must force pause. The eight other cases passed. The two assertions were revised to the deliberately changed contract and individually rerun successfully against the identical player digest; no game-source change was made to satisfy them.
reproduction_history.comfort_before_fix: Four new behavior regressions failed against baseline and passed after the change.
reproduction_history.host_before_fix: The new save-state and visible-return cases failed before their fixes and passed in the full current 12-case run.
reproduction_history.client_identity_before_fix: Three of four real-module cases reproduced the stale .41 default; all four passed after the one-line .42 correction.
reproduction_history.touch_retry: An initial concurrent software-GPU screenshot timed out. The unchanged suite passed 8/8 when run sequentially.
reproduction_history.boot_preseal_hold: Initial actual-index attempt stopped at the still-.41 inventory. After full sealing the actual source passed all four cases.

review.resolution: Corrected shared Supabase client default and verified public client plus saved-session identity with the complete actual module.
